newsitem.title: CHINA: Coca-Cola triples size of Hangzhou plant.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola triples size of Hangzhou plant.

text.p: The Coca-Cola Co said on Monday its has tripled the size of its bottling plant in China's eastern city of Hangzhou to meet increasing consumer demand.
The Coca-Cola bottler, Hangzhou BC Foods Co Ltd, had poured an additional $20 million into its operation, which now employs about 500 people, Coca-Cola said.

The plant's area was increased by 50,000 square metres, making it one of the largest of its kind in China, it said. Coca-Cola estimates it has 40 million potential consumers in the eastern province of Zhejiang.
The Hangzhou facility is 60 percent owned by BC Development Co Ltd, a joint venture between Coca-Cola, Swire Beverages Ltd and China International Trust and Investment Corp.
The remaining equity is split between China National Cereals, Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp, which has 20 percent, and Hangzhou Tea Factory with the remainder.
